overall: The AG found the Art Committee fell within the Connelly exception because the library Manager created it to advise the Manager, who held final authority, so it was not a public body and no violation occurred.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Newton Free Library Art Committee withheld agendas and minutes of its 2023 meetings from the public.
allegations.key_passage: For these reasons we find that the Committee was not a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law and therefore could not have violated the Law.
